explicit_branch_audits.meaning: Non-nil URL adds the three current-image actions; nil skips them. The pseudocode reverses this condition.

limitations: Original bytes were inspected and hashed; the supplied binary was not executed. Runtime fixtures execute the reconstructed generated Logos bodies.

UIKit/private-host objects, network reads, photo writes, URL opening and canonical helper classes are intercepted. These tests do not establish behavior of a live YouTube host or actual photo/network services.
Obfuscation bookkeeping, literal-decode initialization and protection syscalls are omitted.

Readable source preserves known quirks: repeated gesture installation, no alpha restoration, unchecked decorated-avatar child index, allocation before an instance font call, and original menu creation even for missing text.
